hook: A U.S. Air Force ISR aircraft operating under Operation Inherent Resolve submitted this mission report to AARO documenting five UAP sightings over Iraq on May 6, 2022: one described as resembling a 'possible missile' and four others as 'possible birds,' all observed via Full Motion Video sensor.
why_it_matters: This report represents one of the earliest operational-unit UAP reports formally submitted to AARO from an active combat theater, demonstrating that UAP reporting protocols reached front-line ISR assets under USCENTCOM. The document shows how aircrew applied visual reconnaissance (VISRECCE) tradecraft to characterize UAPs in real time, distinguishing between a missile-like object and bird-like objects within the same observation window. Its classification as SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY indicates the sighting was shared across Five Eyes partners.

key_findings.finding: The first UAP observed at 1514Z was described using visual reconnaissance language as resembling a possible missile traversing the sensor field-of-view near a specific MGRS grid coordinate.

quotes.text: AT 1514Z 1.4a OBSERVED A UAP WITH THE VISRECCE OF A POSSIBLE 1.4a MISSILE FLY ACROSS THE FOV IVO 38SMC531.4a961.4a

key_findings.finding: Five total UAPs were observed over a nearly four-and-a-half hour window from 1514Z to 1934Z, with the four subsequent objects assessed as more consistent with birds than the initial missile-like object.

quotes.text: FROM 1514Z to 1934Z, 1.4a OBSERVED 5X UAP FLY ACROSS THE SCREEN. AT 1514Z 1.4a OBSERVED A UAP WITH THE VISRECCE OF A POSSIBLE 1.4a MISSILE FLY ACROSS THE FOV IVO 38SMC531.4a961.4a 1.4a PROCEEDED TO SEE 4X OTHER UAPS IN THEIR FOV UNTIL 1934Z. ALL 4X REMAINING UAP FIT CLOSER TO THE PROFILE OF POSSIBLE BIRDS.

key_findings.finding: Dust conditions substantially degraded Full Motion Video sensor effectiveness against ground targets throughout the mission, which contextualizes the sensor limitations under which the UAP observations were made.

quotes.text: DUST HINDERED MOST FMV COLLECTION OF THE GROUND.
Weather: (SECRET\\REL TO USA, FVEY) DUST HINDERED MOST FMV COLLECTION OF THE GROUND.

key_findings.finding: The aircraft was conducting combined reconnaissance and XCAS (Expeditionary Close Air Support) with both IMINT and SIGINT taskings under Operation Inherent Resolve, operated by the 432 Air Expeditionary Wing through the 609 CAOC.

key_findings.finding: The mission report was formally approved for release to AARO under USCENTCOM MDR 25-0093 and declassified by the USCENTCOM Chief of Staff in October 2025, with a 25-year original declassification date of May 2047.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: The report was formally approved for release to AARO under USCENTCOM MDR 25-0093, making it a direct operational input to AARO's UAP investigation mandate.
The document is classified SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY throughout, indicating the UAP sighting was shared with all Five Eyes intelligence partners.
